title: Competitive Audit Protocol for Aldo Moro's Works
author: Sebastian Barzaghi
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bxbipike

steps.title: Select and Evaluate Digital Editions
steps.instruction: Select a sample of 30 editions for analysis based on criteria for reviewing scholarly digital editions (Sahle 2014). Evaluate each edition across the following aspects: Documentation, Audience, Representation, Data model, Browse, Search, Indices, Quality of the presentation, Metadata, Identification, Technical interfaces, Formats, OS-OA, and Additional features.

steps.title: Score the Evaluated Aspects
steps.instruction: Assign a score to each aspect of each edition based on the following scales:

substeps.instruction: For all aspects except Audience and Data model, assign: 0 (total absence/lack of quality), 0.5 (suboptimal implementation), or 1 (optimal implementation).
For Audience, assign: 'ns' (not specified), 'specialist' (domain experts), 'general' (laymen), or 'both'.
For Data model, assign: 'TEI' (Text Encoding Initiative), 'RDF' (Resource Description Framework), or 'other'.

steps.title: Create CSV Dataset
steps.instruction: Collect the title, URL, and assigned scores for each edition into a CSV dataset (benchmark-moro.csv), where each row represents a digital edition and each column represents an aspect.

steps.title: Perform Data Analysis and Visualization
steps.instruction: Use a Jupyter Notebook with numpy and pandas for data processing, and matplotlib and seaborn for visualization to analyze the dataset.

substeps.instruction: For each aspect, group and count editions by their score/value and create a vertical bar chart with a descriptive title, a bottom spine listing values (0, 0.5, 1), and colored bars (0=red, 0.5=yellow, 1=green, literal value=purple) with integer counts on top.
Plot the total score for each edition in a descending vertical bar chart, displaying the score as a real number on top of each bar.

steps.title: Select Reference Models
steps.instruction: Identify a subset of editions to serve as reference models for design and development. For the National Edition of Aldo Moro's works, select editions with a total score greater than or equal to 8.

steps.title: Analyze Reference Model Profiles
steps.instruction: Create radar graphs for the selected reference editions to visualize strengths and weaknesses, where the shape of the colored area is determined by the score given to each quantifiable aspect.
